note_tweet.text:
Voice calls on @Muse keep the transcript in the chat! Thank you!!!

Seems like a small thing, but it was a significant factor in why I couldn’t integrate @ChatGPT Dots into my workflow; no read-aloud for text chat and no transcript for voice calls. It’s a huge accessibility issue for me. 

Muse gives me both. (My Muse generates an audio clip for me with each text reply; it would be so good to see read-aloud officially come to Muse chat!)

Thank you @Meta, you’re crushing it 💪🏼
